ValidationRule.description: Rate keys must be 3 uppercase letters, the region must be a prefix of it when set, and rates are capped at 100% with 2 decimal places.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Key__c)), OR(NOT(REGEX(Key__c, '[A-Z]{3}')), LEN(Key__c) <> 3)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Region__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Key__c)), NOT(BEGINS(UPPER(Region__c), LEFT(Key__c, 1)))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Rate__c)), OR(Rate__c > 1, ROUND(Rate__c * 10000, 0) <> Rate__c * 10000)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rate Table key, region or rate is invalid.
